# Spec: Removing legacy skills and agents

**Generated by:** li-plan, 2026-09-25
**Status:** APPROVED for implementation by the operator's 09:08 CEST instruction.
**Plan:** [plan.md](plan.md)

## Architecture overview

Consolidate the public workflow surface, not the working capabilities. Keep the nine
cycle phases, engineering modules, useful agent roles, generic review/ship/freeze/perfbench
entries, native client support, shared helpers and real browser/document providers.
One integration coordinator owns six attributable implementation lanes and the aggregate PR.
Two separate review sessions assess the integrated candidate, specification first.

The starting commit is `d285a33283ec90341b79f3d093d1e9ca6a1504ce`. The supplied
historical audit predates its implementation and is reference evidence, not authority
to remove functioning features. Historical task numbers below remain identifiers;
obsolete instructions and unapproved external mutations are not execution requirements.

## Data model / interfaces / contracts

Use the existing work-map v1, swarm coordination v1 and shared review/QA v2 contracts.
Preserve exact content, attempt, work, profile and independently corroborated review
binding, latest-decision semantics and mandatory QA (ADRs 0028/0029). No replacement
schema, heading/regex clearance or fabricated independent actor is permitted.
Preserve owned context selection/recovery, old saves, native transactional install
receipts, no-Python bare installation, native path identity and exact strict CI coverage.

## Constraints

- No model mandate, credentials, production changes, presentation publication, branch-rule
  bypass, history rewrite, unrelated remote deletion or old PR editing.
- Preserve third-party notices for retained covered content; no encoded attribution.
- No optional removal merely to meet the historical skill count. Measure the final count.
- No new third-party dependency, including the refused PDF reader dependency.
- The 09:13 CEST upstream update removes the PDF reader `check_pdf.py`, not the writer.
  Do not preserve/reintroduce that reader or claim it passed.
- Frozen until PR #93 merges: `skills/generate-pdf/scripts/check_pdf.py`,
  `bin/li-copilot.py`, `lib/capability-selections.json`, `skills/generate-pdf/SKILL.md`,
  `tests/README.md`, `tests/integration/document-pdf.py`, its `.sh` entry,
  `tests/integration/copilot-kit.py`, `tests/unit/catalog-selection.py`,
  `tests/unit/generate-skills-present.sh`, all derived catalogs/wiki/adapters,
  `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.claude/plans/universal-implementation`,
  `.claude/decisions`, `.claude/memory`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Rebase the isolated integration branch onto verified merged main before fan-in, as
  explicitly instructed by the parent. Keep worker results intact and revalidate them.

## Open decisions and evidence limits

Routine naming/consolidation is authorized. Only a genuinely new material choice goes to
the parent. Upstream completion, hosted CI, real client observations and independence
are observations to obtain, never assumptions. Local missing tools/permissions are
reported without bypass; required acceptance remains open until evidenced.

## Accepted PDF fix-forward requirements

Go Live's Phase 4 observations **A5-31** and **A5-32** are part of this cleanup's
existing R4/R8 leaves `7.1.a` and `10.5.a`. The selection example and adapter/native
guide must describe the retained writer/print path without claiming the removed
reader or inspection. Completion follows the original selected required QA inventory:
missing mandatory text/page/visual observations remain BLOCKED, with any useful
partial artifact separately disclosed. Never revise obligations after observing
results or restore/install the removed reader. Source-contract checks and shared
QA negative cases must cover this distinction; include both IDs in final reviews.
